metadata.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Steps Up as Silicon Valley’s Loudest Voice Against AI Slowdown - WSJ

content.text:
If Anthropic’s Dario Amodei is the tech leader most stoking fears about the power of AI, Nvidia’s NVDA 1.34%increase; up pointing triangle Jensen Huang is increasingly becoming the industry’s most prominent voice pushing back.
At one of the season’s signature tech conferences, Huang on Tuesday held a large audience rapt discussing the positive potential of artificial intelligence with Salesforce Chief Executive Marc Benioff. As the two awkwardly navigated walking and talking through the audience, the Nvidia CEO directed Benioff to follow him.
